newsitem.title: USA: Florida doctors indicted in Medicare scam.
newsitem.headline: Florida doctors indicted in Medicare scam.

text.p: A Tampa grand jury on Thursday indicted two doctors and the manager of a medical center who allegedly refered patients to a medical laboratory in an insurance scam.
Brothers Larry and Gary Levine were doctors at the Family Medical Center at Palm Harbour, Florida. Kishor Vaghela was the office manager.

The indictment charged all three with soliciting and receiving payments in return for referring patients to a clinical medical laboratory in St.Petersburg. They are aslo charged with violating Medicare regulations which prohibit such payments. Vaghela is also charged with conspiracy to obstruct justice.
If convicted they face maximum sentences of five years in prison and a $425,000 fine on each count.
